queries.query: Dadu Pakistan official cadastral parcel map land records Sindh Board of Revenue GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Board of Revenue, Government of Sindh land-record authority and its Sindh Zameen public portal. The portal's current map flow identifies Dadu district, Dadu taluka, and a Dadu-specific deh-map route. BOR's official pages describe Sindh cadastral/deh-map and land-record responsibilities. No public parcel-polygon service was identified.

queries.query: دادو سنڌ سرڪاري ڪادستر نقشو زمين رڪارڊ / دادو سندھ سرکاری کادستر نقشہ زمین ریکارڈ
queries.result: First-party-language discovery led to the same official Sindh Zameen/BOR portal, which presents Maps/Deh Maps and Sindhi/Urdu labels. No separate Dadu parcel API or downloadable safe parcel geometry was exposed.

registryBasis: The official Board of Revenue Sindh portal provides a Dadu-specific public Deh Maps flow. The current Dadu taluka endpoint returned an anonymous HTML fragment reporting 62 available Dehs and listing Deh Dadu. This establishes local/district map/procedure evidence, not parcel-level API coverage or legal-boundary completeness.
